description: Checkpoint for the Daily Code Review routine. Records the last commit on the default branch (main) that has been reviewed. The next run diffs main from this SHA forward. Update after each run.

lastRun.notes: Diff of 21 commits / 114 files (~2.1k insertions, ~1.1k deletions). Reviewed and nothing cleared the bar — every substantive change is correct, well-tested, and pattern-conformant. Prior-run findings VERIFIED RESOLVED: #1412 (bfb98c2) closes ADS-1261 and ADS-1262 — the two findings filed last run. ADS-1261: shared requireDraftAwareReadScope in command-runner.ts (read-side mirror of requireDraftScope; draft = owner/super_admin only, rescue branch only post-draft) wired into all four read paths (getApplication in read-handlers.ts, listDocuments in document-handlers.ts, listHomeVisits in home-visit-handlers.ts, listTimelineNotes in timeline-notes-handlers.ts — the last via loadOwnerOrThrow), each now loading `status`; unknown-id still 404s first; regression tests per handler. ADS-1262: publishFieldPermissionActionTaken emits auth.actionTaken (aggregateType 'fieldPermission') on upsert/bulkUpsert/delete, delete now routed through withTransaction (publish-after-commit), no-op delete emits nothing; payload tests per handler. Both correct. Other substantive commits, all verified clean: #1407 (3f43011) ADS-1258 bulkUpdateUsers now reuses the ELEVATED_ROLES guard (was super_admin-only) — matches single-user path, correct. #1409 (0f6cf32) moves assertNotPlaceholder into readSecret so PRINCIPAL_SIGNING_KEY/UPLOAD_SIGNING_SECRET (read via readSecret directly) are covered; direct value returned untrimmed but placeholder-checked trimmed — behaviour preserved, correct improvement (refs ADS-1259). #1413 (9fd21ff) ADS-1257 maskRecipient/maskRecipients (first local-part char + domain; handles Name<addr> and no-@ -> '***'); console drops htmlPreview entirely (kills OTP-token leak), resend/ethereal mask recipient on all paths — correct. #1422 (f99833c) ADS-1251 gateway_ws_redis_adapter_up gauge, lazy + registry-change-aware, ready->1 / close|end->0, seed-from-status, pub/sub independent — signal not readiness gate, well-tested. #1418 (b0de925) ADS-1248 two correct API repoints (support addResponse /reply->/responses; PetManagement PATCH->PUT users/:id) + audit-doc re-triage. #1424 (0a9845b) ADS-1255 gateway protected-by-default backstop: tokenless request to a route without config.public is 401'd; infra endpoints (/health /metrics /openapi.json) via collision-free prefix exception; fail-closed (forgotten flag 401s loudly, caught in tests), CORS preflight short-circuits before hook, handler requirePermission gates remain as defense-in-depth — carefully designed, 1346 tests pass.
